targets.query: SELECT CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER)*MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS time,SUM(is_failure) AS failures,SUM(CASE WHEN error_category='http_429' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rate_limits FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Reliability by Provider

panels.description: Attempts grouped by trace_id. Empty when clients do not send X-Llmtap-Trace/traceparent; logical requests cannot otherwise be inferred.
panels.noValue: No trace/retry metadata was reported by clients.

targets.query: SELECT trace_id,COUNT(*) AS attempts,MAX(attempt) AS max_attempts,SUM(is_failure) AS failures FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND trace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trace_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT trace_id,COUNT(*) AS attempts,MAX(attempt) AS max_attempts,SUM(is_failure) AS failures FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND trace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trace_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 50
